message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerabilities were confirmed for the deduplicated products in `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` during the 24-hour window from 2026-09-25 23:40 UTC to 2026-09-26 23:40 UTC.

### Findings

No candidate met all inclusion requirements: credible sourcing, a supported match to the monitored product scope, and first disclosure or a material security update within the scan window.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries and services. The newest entries in the [official MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) were dated 2026-09-24, before this scan's cutoff, so no MongoDB-family advisory qualified.

### Freshness review

Several Elasticsearch and Kibana records entered NVD/GitHub feeds on September 26, but Elastic's first-party advisories were posted on September 25 at approximately 08:31-08:35 UTC, before the cutoff, and were excluded. RabbitMQ and WordPress candidates were likewise earlier disclosures rather than new issues in this window.

### Review priority

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported vulnerabilities in this scan window. Continue normal monitoring; older advisories were not relabeled as new.
